tools.name: predictive-analytics_kmeans-cluster
tools.description: Lloyd k-means with k-means++ seeding, optional standardisation, nInit restarts, silhouette and inertia for a k range, and stable label renumbering when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with columns and rows; optional k, kRange, standardize, seed, nInit, maxIter. Returns k, labels, centr

tools.name: predictive-analytics_dbscan-cluster
tools.description: Density-based clustering with Euclidean or haversine distance, core/border/noise labelling, and an optional k-distance knee suggestion for eps when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with columns, rows, and eps; optional minSamples, metric, kDistance. Returns labels, clusters, noise, core

tools.name: predictive-analytics_pca
tools.description: Centre (and optionally standardise) columns, decompose the covariance, and return eigenvalues, explained ratios, signed loadings and optional scores when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with columns and rows; optional standardize, components, returnScores. Returns eigenvalues, explaine

tools.name: predictive-analytics_decision-tree-train
tools.description: Fit a classification or regression CART tree with depth and leaf limits, readable rules, feature importance and optional predictions when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with task, columns, rows, and target; optional maxDepth, minSamplesLeaf, predict. Returns rules, tree, featureImport

tools.name: predictive-analytics_random-forest-importance
tools.description: Train a small seeded random forest, report out-of-bag accuracy or R², and estimate permutation feature importance with Fisher-Yates shuffles when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with task, columns, rows, and target; optional trees, maxFeatures, maxDepth, seed, permutationRepeats, minSa

tools.name: predictive-analytics_kaplan-meier-survival
tools.description: Estimate group Kaplan-Meier curves with Greenwood log-log confidence intervals, median survival, survival at chosen times, and a multi-group log-rank test when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with subjects; optional confidence, at. Returns groups and logRank (groups includes group, med

tools.name: predictive-analytics_cox-regression
tools.description: Maximise the Cox partial likelihood with Efron or Breslow ties, return hazard ratios with SEs, concordance, and a rank-time proportional-hazards check when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with subjects; optional ties, confidence. Returns coefficients, logLikelihood, concordance, phTest

tools.name: predictive-analytics_cohort-retention
tools.description: Build day/week/month cohort retention in classic or rolling mode from signup and activity dates, with partial-period flags and a size-weighted curve when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with events and asOf; optional period, mode, timezone. Returns cohorts and weightedCurve (cohorts in

tools.name: predictive-analytics_rfm-segment
tools.description: Score customers 1–bins on recency, frequency and monetary value with average ranks for ties, then map scores to Champions/Loyal/New/At risk/Hibernating or a custom rule list when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with optional customers, transactions, asOf, bins, segmentMap. Returns cust

tools.name: predictive-analytics_clv-bg-nbd
tools.description: Fit BG/NBD purchase frequency and Gamma-Gamma spend models, then return P(alive), expected purchases over a horizon, expected value and undiscounted CLV per customer when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with customers; optional horizon, margin, minRepeatCustomers. Returns bgnbd, gammaG

tools.name: predictive-analytics_market-basket-rules
tools.description: Mine frequent itemsets and association rules with support, confidence, lift, leverage and conviction from caller baskets when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with baskets; optional minSupport, minConfidence, maxItemsetSize, maxRules. Returns rules (rules includes antecedent, consequent

tools.name: predictive-analytics_changepoint-detect
tools.description: Detect mean or mean-variance changepoints with PELT, BIC/AIC or custom penalties, and MAD-based noise scaling when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with values; optional model, penalty, minSegment. Returns changepoints, segments, sigma, and penaltyValue (segments includes start, end, me

tools.name: predictive-analytics_classification-metrics
tools.description: Compute ROC-AUC, average precision, Brier score, confusion at a threshold, Youden-optimal threshold and equal-width calibration bins from binary labels and scores when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with labels and scores; optional threshold, calibrationBins. Returns rocAuc, prAuc, br

tools.name: predictive-analytics_correlation-analysis
tools.description: Pairwise Pearson/Spearman/Kendall correlations with p-values, optional partial correlations, and Holm/BH/Bonferroni adjustment across pair-method tests when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with columns and rows; optional methods, partial, adjust. Returns pairs, partial, rowsUsed, and c

tools.name: predictive-analytics_propensity-score-match
tools.description: Fit logistic propensity scores, match treated to controls 1:1 on the logit within a caliper, and report SMD balance and common-support counts when scoring customers or a predictive model. Call with units; optional caliperSdLogit, replacement, order, seed. Returns model, caliper, pairs, unmatchedTrea
